# Independent registered launcher review

32 checks passed, no skips, against unchanged source snapshots. No unresolved blocker was found in the reviewed launcher/worker boundary. This is synthetic engineering evidence, not an executed archival study.

The final run used the real supervisor and real worker inside actual user/network namespaces for four cases: complete execution, early development NO_GO, publication failure after eight stage seals, and registration failure before target phase. Scientific and registration dependencies were explicit constructed stubs; the worker's canonical-origin check was substituted only inside this test child. Other checks used constructed sealed stage chains and public projection fixtures, including the real aggregate projector and real anchored file sink.

The tests preserve the two initial producer failures (path traversal and supervisor returned/captured disagreement), subsequent corrections, and the independent harness's initial Fraction serialization failure. A source-drift intermediate pass remains exploratory. Final execution and all eight synthetic child/operational receipts are hash-bound in review-v1.json.

The parent now binds metadata provenance and feature identity, validates persisted stage chains and outer public seals, and clears a verdict on reproduction mismatch. After a successful terminal it decodes private stage receipts for persistence verification; this is explicitly separate from worker scientific-consumer access counters. The parent trusts the registered typed public projector rather than re-evaluating metrics from a self-sealed document.

No actual scientific source, private feature file, target, source-group allocation, allocation entropy provider, or live CI endpoint was accessed. The registration/public-tag gate and complete custody flow have separate owners and evidence. These checks do not certify a scientific result, future conditional coverage, physical properties, hostile-code privacy, or an instantaneous hard memory cap.

Run from discovery with `python .cache/mpea-study-custody/review_launcher/run_review.py NEW_EVIDENCE_NAME`; use a fresh evidence name. The suite is currently scratch-layout review code, not a promoted portable user entry point.
